title: The lords against Dong Zhuo
summary: From Cao Cao's forged summons to Lü Bu's spear: the coalition, the passes, the burning of Luoyang and the chain of stratagems.
summary_zh: 从曹操发矫诏到吕布刺董：联军会盟、虎牢关下、火烧洛阳、连环计。

steps.text: [Embellished] Cao Cao's dagger fails and he flees Luoyang.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】献刀不成，曹操逃出洛阳。

steps.text: [Embellished] Eighteen lords meet at Suanzao and choose Yuan Shao.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】十八路诸侯会盟酸枣，推袁绍为盟主。

steps.text: [Fiction] The lords advance on the passes; Hua Xiong falls before the wine cools.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】联军进逼关隘，关羽温酒斩华雄。

steps.text: [Fiction] Three heroes against Lü Bu at Hulao Pass.
[History] Dong Zhuo burns Luoyang and drags the court west.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】董卓火烧洛阳，挟天子西迁长安。

steps.text: [History] Cao Cao alone pursues, and is beaten on the Bian.
[Embellished] Sun Jian reaches the ruins first and finds the jade seal.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】孙坚率先进入洛阳废墟，得传国玉玺。

steps.text: [Fiction] In Chang'an, Wang Yun's chain of stratagems.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】长安城中，王允巧使连环计。

steps.text: [Embellished] The halberd in the Phoenix Pavilion.
[History] Lü Bu kills Dong Zhuo.

title: The battle of Guandu
summary: Yuan Shao comes south with a hundred thousand men; Cao Cao holds the river line with a fraction of that, and wins with one night raid.
summary_zh: 袁绍十万大军南下，曹操以寡敌众，凭一次夜袭乌巢反败为胜。

steps.text: [Embellished] Chen Lin's proclamation: the war of words first.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】陈琳檄文，先打一场笔墨之战。

steps.text: [History] Yuan Shao's army comes south; Guan Yu kills Yan Liang at Baima.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】袁绍大军南下，关羽白马斩颜良。

steps.text: [Fiction] Wen Chou falls at Yanjin.
[History] Guan Yu seals the gifts and leaves to find Liu Bei.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】关羽挂印封金，辞曹寻兄。

steps.text: [History] Months of stalemate at Guandu; Cao Cao's grain runs low.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】官渡相持数月，曹军粮尽。

steps.text: [History] Xu You comes over; Cao Cao runs out barefoot.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】许攸来投，曹操跣足出迎。

steps.text: [History] The night raid on Wuchao: Yuan Shao's grain burns.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】夜袭乌巢，火烧袁军粮草。

steps.text: [History] Yuan Shao's army collapses; Ju Shou dies unbowed.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】袁军崩溃，沮授不屈而死。

steps.text: [History] Cangting: Yuan Shao beaten again.
[History] The Yuan brothers quarrel; Cao Cao floods Ye and takes the north.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】袁氏兄弟相争，曹操水灌邺城，平定河北。

steps.text: [History] Beyond the Wall to White Wolf Mountain.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】远征塞外，白狼山破乌桓。

title: Flight from Xinye: Changban
summary: Cao Cao comes south, Jingzhou surrenders, and Liu Bei flees with a hundred thousand people; Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei hold the road.
summary_zh: 曹操南下，荆州投降，刘备携十万百姓南撤，赵云、张飞断后。

steps.text: [History] Liu Cong surrenders Jingzhou without a fight.
[Fiction] Zhuge Liang burns Xinye behind him.
[History] A hundred thousand people follow Liu Bei south.
[Embellished] Cao Cao's cavalry catch them at Changban; Zhao Yun rides back for the heir.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】曹军铁骑追至长坂，赵云单骑救主。

steps.text: [Fiction] Lady Mi's well.
[Fiction] Liu Bei throws down his son.
[Embellished] Zhang Fei holds the bridge.
[History] Guan Yu's fleet at the Han ford, and on to Xiakou.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】汉津口关羽接应，退往夏口。

title: The Red Cliffs
summary: The most famous campaign in Chinese fiction: the embassy, the stratagems, the fire and the flight. Watch the colours under the markers: one battle that is history, ringed with schemes that are not.
summary_zh: 中国小说中最著名的战役：出使、连环妙计、火烧赤壁、败走华容。留意标记下的颜色：一场真实的大战，四周环绕着虚构的计谋。

steps.text: [Embellished] Zhuge Liang argues down Wu's scholars.
[History] Lu Su: anyone may surrender but you.
[History] Sun Quan cuts the table.
[Embellished] Cao Cao's fleet comes down the river; Zhou Yu sails up to meet it.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】曹军顺江东下，周瑜溯江西上迎敌。

steps.text: [Fiction] Jiang Gan and the forged letter.
[Fiction] A hundred thousand arrows borrowed in the fog.
[Fiction] Huang Gai takes the beating.
[Fiction] Pang Tong talks Cao Cao into chaining his ships.
[Embellished] Cao Cao's song on the moonlit river.
[Fiction] The east wind from the seven-star altar.
[History] Fire at the Red Cliffs.
[Fiction] Cao Cao flees; every laugh brings an ambush.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】曹操败走，三笑引出伏兵。

steps.text: [Fiction] Huarong: Guan Yu lets him go.

title: Tong Pass: Ma Chao against Cao Cao
summary: Ma Chao brings the northwest to Tong Pass; Cao Cao loses his beard and robe, crosses the river behind him, and wins with a blotted letter.
summary_zh: 马超起关西之兵进据潼关；曹操割须弃袍，北渡黄河迂回，一封涂改的书信离间马韩。

steps.text: [Embellished] Ma Chao marches on Tong Pass.
[Embellished] Cao Cao comes west; at the river he cuts his beard and throws off his robe.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】曹操西征，渡河时割须弃袍。

steps.text: [Embellished] Xu Chu strips to fight Ma Chao.
[History] The blotted letter.

title: Liu Bei takes Shu
summary: Invited in as a guest, Liu Bei turns on his host: Fu, Fallen Phoenix Slope, Yan Yan, Zhang Ren, Ma Chao, and Chengdu.
summary_zh: 应邀入川作客，反客为主：涪城之会、落凤坡、义释严颜、捉张任、收马超，终取成都。

steps.text: [Embellished] Zhang Song brings the map of Shu.
[History] Up the gorges to meet Liu Zhang at Fu.
[History] Liu Bei turns on his host.
[Embellished] Pang Tong dies at Fallen Phoenix Slope.
[History] Zhang Fei comes up the river and spares Yan Yan.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】张飞溯江而上，义释严颜。

steps.text: [History] Zhang Ren is captured at the Goose Bridge.
[Embellished] Ma Chao comes over.
[History] Chengdu surrenders.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】刘璋出降，刘备领益州牧。

title: The struggle for Hanzhong
summary: Cao Cao takes Hanzhong from Zhang Lu; Liu Bei takes it from Cao Cao. Mount Dingjun, the empty camp, and 'chicken rib'.
summary_zh: 曹操从张鲁手中夺得汉中，刘备又从曹操手中夺走：定军山、空营计、鸡肋。

steps.text: [History] Cao Cao takes Hanzhong.
[History] Zhang Fei beats Zhang He at Wakou.
[Fiction] Huang Zhong takes Tiandang Mountain.
[History] Mount Dingjun: Huang Zhong kills Xiahou Yuan.
[History] Cao Cao comes himself; Zhao Yun's open gate on the Han River.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】曹操亲至，赵云汉水空营退敌。

steps.text: [Embellished] 'Chicken rib'.
[Embellished] Cao Cao falls back through the Xie Valley.
[History] Liu Bei, King of Hanzhong.

title: Guan Yu's last campaign
summary: At the height of his fame Guan Yu floods seven armies; within months Jingzhou is gone and so is he.
summary_zh: 关羽水淹七军，威震华夏；数月之间，荆州失守，身死临沮。

steps.text: [Embellished] The single-sword meeting with Lu Su.
[History] Guan Yu marches north on Xiangyang and Fancheng.
[Embellished] Pang De brings his coffin.
[Embellished] Seven armies drowned.
[Embellished] Scraping the bone.
[History] Lü Meng crosses in white and takes Jiangling behind him.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】吕蒙白衣渡江，袭取江陵。

steps.text: [History] Xu Huang breaks the siege.
[History] Retreat to Maicheng.
[History] Captured at Linju.
[History] His head buried at Luoyang.

title: Yiling: Liu Bei's revenge
summary: Liu Bei marches down the gorges to avenge Guan Yu and is burned out by a young scholar; he dies at Baidi.
summary_zh: 刘备为关羽报仇，顺江东下，却被书生陆逊火烧连营，终于白帝托孤。

steps.text: [History] Zhang Fei is murdered on the eve of the war.
[History] Liu Bei marches down the gorges.
[History] Sun Quan bows to Wei to protect his back.
[Fiction] Old Huang Zhong falls.
[Fiction] Liu Bei gets his enemies.
[History] The scholar Lu Xun takes command and waits.
[History] Fire along seven hundred li.
[Fiction] Liu Bei flees; Lu Xun is lost in the stone maze.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】刘备败走，陆逊误入八阵图。

steps.text: [History] Baidi: Liu Bei entrusts his son to Zhuge Liang.

title: Seven times Meng Huo
summary: Zhuge Liang marches into the far south and wins hearts as well as battles: poisoned springs, wild beasts, rattan armour.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮南征，攻心为上：哑泉毒水、猛兽助阵、藤甲兵，七擒七纵。

steps.text: [History] The army marches south.
[Fiction] The first capture.
[Embellished] Across the Lu in the fifth month.
[Fiction] A false surrender, the third capture.
[Fiction] The poisoned springs.
[Fiction] Wooden beasts against wild ones.
[Fiction] The rattan-armoured army burns.
[Embellished] The seventh capture: the south will not rebel again.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】七擒孟获，南人不复反矣。

steps.text: [Fiction] Heads of dough for the river spirits.

title: Out through Qishan: the northern expeditions
summary: Five campaigns north from Hanzhong, and Wei's answers to each: Jieting, the empty fort, Chencang, Shanggui, and the Wuzhang plains.
summary_zh: 自汉中五次北伐，魏军一一应对：街亭、空城、陈仓、上邽割麦、五丈原。

steps.text: [History] The memorial on leaving.
[History] Out through Qishan; three commanderies go over.
[History] Jiang Wei comes over.
[History] Sima Yi's lightning march on Meng Da.
[History] Zhang He reaches Jieting; Ma Su has left the water.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】张郃驰援街亭，马谡失守。

steps.text: [Fiction] The empty fort.
[History] Ma Su executed, in tears.
[Embellished] Second expedition: Chencang.
[History] Third: Wudu and Yinping.
[Embellished] Fourth: the wheat at Shanggui, Zhang He at Mumen.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】四出，割上邽之麦，木门道射杀张郃。

steps.text: [Embellished] Fifth: up the Xie valley with the wooden oxen.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】五出斜谷，木牛流马运粮。

steps.text: [Fiction] Rain saves Sima Yi at Shangfang Valley.
[History] The star falls at Wuzhang.

title: The fall of Shu
summary: Wei comes by two roads: Zhong Hui is held at Jiange, Deng Ai goes round through seven hundred li of wilderness, and Shu surrenders.
summary_zh: 魏军两路伐蜀：钟会被阻剑阁，邓艾偷渡阴平七百里，蜀汉投降。

steps.text: [History] Jiang Wei farming at Tazhong, far from court.
[History] Zhong Hui pours through Hanzhong; Jiang Wei races back to Jiange.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】钟会大军经汉中南下，姜维退守剑阁。

steps.text: [Fiction] Zhong Hui at Zhuge Liang's tomb.
[History] Deng Ai through the Yinping wilderness.
[History] Zhuge Zhan dies at Mianzhu.
[History] Liu Shan surrenders; Liu Chen dies in the temple.
[History] Deng Ai carried off in a cage.
[History] Jiang Wei's last scheme.
[History] 'I am happy here.'

title: All under Jin
summary: Jin finishes it: Yang Hu and Lu Kang's border, Du Yu's bamboo, Wang Jun's fleet, and Sun Hao's surrender.
summary_zh: 晋灭吴：羊陆之交、杜预破竹、王濬楼船、孙皓出降。

steps.text: [History] Sima Yan founds Jin.
[History] Yang Hu and Lu Kang.
[History] Sun Hao's cruelty.
[History] Jin comes by land and water; Wang Jun's fleet sails the whole Yangzi.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】晋军水陆并进，王濬楼船顺江东下。

steps.text: [History] Du Yu: like splitting bamboo.
[History] Sun Hao surrenders. Long divided, the realm is one.

title: Cao Cao: a hero for an age of chaos
summary: From a young officer against the Yellow Turbans to King of Wei: eighteen stops, most of them marches.
summary_zh: 从讨伐黄巾的年轻骑都尉到魏王：十八站，大多是行军。

steps.text: [History] The young Cao Cao at Changshe.
[Embellished] The failed dagger, the flight, Lü Boshe.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】献刀出逃，误杀吕伯奢。

steps.text: [History] Alone after Dong Zhuo, beaten on the Bian.
[History] Revenge on Xuzhou.
[History] Lü Bu takes his province; fire at Puyang.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】吕布袭兖州，濮阳火中脱险。

steps.text: [History] The emperor to Xu.
[History] Defeat at Wan: Dian Wei dies at the gate.
[History] Hair for a head.
[History] Lü Bu ends at the White Gate Tower.
[Embellished] Talking of heroes over wine.
[History] Guandu, and the raid on Wuchao.
[History] The north united, beyond the Wall.
[History] South to Jingzhou.
[Fiction] The Red Cliffs, and Huarong.
[Embellished] Tong Pass: beard and robe.
[History] King of Wei.
[History] Hanzhong taken, and lost: 'chicken rib'.
[History] Death at Luoyang.

title: Three generations of the Sun
summary: Sun Jian, the Tiger of Jiangdong; Sun Ce, the Little Conqueror; Sun Quan, who held the south for fifty years.
summary_zh: 江东猛虎孙坚、小霸王孙策、坐断东南五十年的孙权。

steps.text: [History] Sun Jian, first over the wall at Wan.
[Embellished] Into Luoyang first; the jade seal.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】率先攻入洛阳，得传国玉玺。

steps.text: [History] Killed at Xian Hill.
[History] Sun Ce and Taishi Ci at Shenting.
[History] The Little Conqueror takes Jiangdong.
[Embellished] Yu Ji, and Sun Ce's death.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】怒斩于吉，伤重而亡。

steps.text: [History] Sun Quan, eighteen, takes over.
[History] Revenge on Huang Zu.
[History] He cuts the table.
[History] The Red Cliffs.
[History] Hefei, and the leap at Xiaoyao Ford.
[History] Jingzhou taken from Guan Yu.
[History] Yiling: Lu Xun burns out Liu Bei.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】夷陵之战，陆逊火烧连营。

steps.text: [History] Sun Quan, emperor.
[History] Fifty years after him, his grandson surrenders.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】五十年后，其孙孙皓出降。

title: Zhao Zilong of Changshan
summary: Thirty years at Liu Bei's side and never beaten in the novel: Jieqiao, Changban, Guiyang, the river, the Han, the five generals.
summary_zh: 追随刘备三十年，在小说里从未败过：界桥、长坂、桂阳、截江、汉水、斩五将。

steps.text: [Embellished] First appearance: saving Gongsun Zan at Jieqiao.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】初登场：界桥救公孙瓒。

steps.text: [Embellished] He finds Liu Bei again.
[Embellished] Changban: the heir in his breastplate.
[Fiction] Liu Bei throws down his son for him.
[History] Guiyang, and the bride he refuses.
[History] He takes back the heir from the river.
[History] The open gate on the Han River: 'courage from head to foot'.
[Embellished] At seventy, five generals in a day.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】年过七旬，力斩五将。

steps.text: [Embellished] His death; Zhuge Liang has lost an arm.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】病逝，诸葛亮如失一臂。

title: Lü Bu: among men, Lü Bu
summary: The greatest fighter of the age and its least trusted man: two adoptive fathers killed, two provinces taken, one halberd shot, one tower.
summary_zh: 天下第一猛将，也是最不可信的人：两弑义父，两夺州郡，辕门射戟，殒命白门楼。

steps.text: [Embellished] Red Hare, and Ding Yuan's head.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】赤兔马与丁原的首级。

steps.text: [Fiction] Three heroes against him at Hulao.
[Fiction] Diaochan.
[Embellished] The halberd in the pavilion.
[History] He kills Dong Zhuo.
[History] He seizes Yan province from Cao Cao.
[History] Beaten at Dingtao.
[Embellished] He takes Xuzhou from Liu Bei.
[History] The halberd at the camp gate.
[History] Cao Cao comes; Xiapi flooded.
[History] The White Gate Tower.

title: Sima Yi: the patient one
summary: Zhuge Liang's great opponent, who outlived him and everyone else, and whose grandson founded Jin.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮的一生之敌，熬过了他，也熬过了所有人；其孙司马炎建立晋朝。

steps.text: [History] Twelve hundred li in eight days.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】八日奔袭一千二百里擒孟达。

steps.text: [Fiction] He turns back from the empty fort.
[Fiction] Outmatched at formations.
[History] The northern plain: he will not fight.
[Fiction] Saved by rain in Shangfang Valley.
[Embellished] Put to flight by a wooden statue.
[History] Four thousand li to Liaodong.
[History] Porridge down his chest.
[History] The coup at Gaoping tomb.
[History] Sixteen years after him, his grandson ends Wei.

title: Jiang Wei: the last campaigner
summary: Zhuge Liang's heir in war, who marched north again and again after him, and tried to save Shu even after it surrendered.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮的军事传人，在他死后屡次北伐，蜀亡之后仍图复国。

steps.text: [History] He comes over to Zhuge Liang.
[Fiction] His false letter to Cao Zhen.
[History] Beaten at Niutou Mountain.
[History] Victory west of the Tao.
[History] Deng Ai waits at Duangu.
[History] Through the Luo valley.
[Fiction] Iron Cage Mountain.
[History] The eunuch, and the retreat to Tazhong.
[History] Back to Jiange to hold Zhong Hui.
[History] The false surrender.

title: Guan Yu: the man and the legend
summary: From the peach garden to Jade Spring Hill. Each step says whether the story is history, embellished, or invented; with Guan Yu more than with anyone, the legend outgrew the man.
summary_zh: 从桃园到玉泉山，每站都标明是正史、演义加工还是虚构。三国人物中，传说超过本人最多的就是关羽。

steps.text: [Fiction] The oath in the peach garden.
[Fiction] Hua Xiong before the wine cools.
[Embellished] Three conditions on Tushan.
[History] Yan Liang at Baima.
[History] He seals the gifts and goes.
[Fiction] Five passes, six generals (switch on the five-passes layer).
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】过五关斩六将（可打开“过五关路线”图层）。

steps.text: [Fiction] The monk Pujing.
[Embellished] Cai Yang at Gucheng.
[Fiction] Huarong: he lets Cao Cao go.
[Embellished] The single-sword meeting.
[Embellished] North to Fancheng; seven armies drowned.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】北伐襄樊，水淹七军。

steps.text: [Embellished] Scraping the bone.
[History] Jiangling lost behind him.
[History] Maicheng, and Linju.
[Fiction] The ghost at Jade Spring Hill.

title: Zhuge Liang
summary: From the thatched cottage to Wuzhang Plains. The novel made him a wizard; the history shows a statesman whose own words survive.
summary_zh: 从草庐到五丈原。小说把他写成了近乎神算的奇人，史书里的他则是一位留下了亲笔文字的政治家。

steps.text: [History] Three visits to the cottage.
[History] The Longzhong plan.
[Embellished] First battle: fire at Bowang.
[Embellished] The embassy to Wu.
[Fiction] The east wind.
[Embellished] Three angers for Zhou Yu.
[History] The charge at Baidi.

[History] The memorial.
[History] Out through Qishan; Jieting lost.
[Fiction] The empty fort.
[History] Ma Su executed, in tears.
[Embellished] Up the Xie valley with the wooden oxen.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】五出斜谷，木牛流马。

steps.text: [Fiction] Seven lamps for more life.
[History] The star falls.

title: Liu Bei, from straw sandals to emperor
title_zh: 刘备：从织席贩履到称帝
summary: A life spent losing and starting again: Zhuo, Xuzhou, Xu, Jingzhou, Chengdu, Hanzhong, Baidi.
summary_zh: 屡败屡起的一生：涿郡、徐州、许都、荆州、成都、汉中、白帝城。

steps.text: [Fiction] The peach garden at Zhuo.
[Embellished] The inspector whipped.
[Embellished] Xuzhou offered to him.
[Embellished] Talking of heroes with Cao Cao.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】与曹操煮酒论英雄。

steps.text: [History] Routed, to Yuan Shao.
[History] Flesh on his thighs.
[Embellished] The leap over the Tan.
[History] Three visits.
[History] South with the people.
[Embellished] A wife from Wu.
[History] Into Shu.
[History] Chengdu.
[History] Hanzhong, and a king's title.
[History] Emperor of Han.
[History] Down the gorges to Yiling, and burned out.
[History] Back to Baidi to die.

title: Long divided, the realm unites
summary: Ninety-six years in fifteen steps, with the great marches of each. Watch the borders change: one Han, a dozen warlords, three states, one Jin.
summary_zh: 十五步走完九十六年，每一步都有当年的大进军。留意疆域的变化：一个汉朝，十几路诸侯，三个国家，最后归于晋。

steps.text: [History] 184: the Yellow Turbans rise across a united Han.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】184年：黄巾起义，汉朝尚是一统。

steps.text: [History] 190: Dong Zhuo burns Luoyang and drags the court west.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】190年：董卓焚洛阳，挟天子西迁。

steps.text: [History] 196: Cao Cao takes the emperor to Xu.
[History] 200: Guandu decides the north.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】200年：官渡之战决定北方归属。

steps.text: [History] 208: the Red Cliffs stop Cao Cao in the south.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】208年：赤壁之战阻止曹操南下。

steps.text: [History] 214: Liu Bei takes Yizhou; three powers.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】214年：刘备取益州，三分之势已成。

steps.text: [History] 220: Cao Pi ends the Han; three emperors follow.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】220年：曹丕代汉，三国相继称帝。

steps.text: [History] 222: Yiling fixes the border between Shu and Wu.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】222年：夷陵之战定下蜀吴边界。

steps.text: [History] 234: Zhuge Liang dies; the north is not retaken.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】234年：诸葛亮病逝，北伐终未成功。

steps.text: [History] 249: the Sima take Wei.
[History] 263: two roads into Shu.
[History] 263: Shu surrenders.
[History] 265: Jin replaces Wei.
[History] 280: Jin by land and water.
[History] 280: Wu surrenders; the realm is one.
